assays.assay_description: Mice were placed individually in a plexiglass chamber (25.5 × 12.5 × 12.5 cm) and video-monitored for 30 min predose and 60 min postdose; head-twitch counts were tallied in 15-min bins, with the 15–30 min window used as primary readout.

application_type.evidence: test articles... administered orally... for a dose of 1 mg/kg (p.o.).

setup_habituation.evidence: Three days prior to any behavioral protocol, mice were... exposed to the testing chamber for at least 5 min each day. Prior to oral administration, mice were video-monitored for 30 min in a plexiglass testing chamber to allow for acclimation.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were freely moving in the plexiglass testing chamber.

food_restriction.evidence: Testing chamber is a plexiglass arena; no food in the apparatus during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: No water bottle in the testing chamber during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Following test article administration, mice were video-monitored for 60 min.

sample_size.evidence: n = 4 mice for psilocybin-treated groups; n = 3 for vehicle group; n = 2 for all other (NPD) groups analyzed.

outcomes.summary: Oral psilocybin (1 mg/kg) significantly increased head-twitch counts vs vehicle, peaking at 15–30 min. Ten NPDs produced statistically significant HTR above vehicle; ester-based ES01, ES02, ES03 induced HTR equivalent to psilocybin, and T01 and SE01 also produced notable HTR despite lower plasma psilocin.
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin produced statistically enhanced HTR up to 90 min postadministration, with a peak intensity occurring within the 15–30 min observation window... ten of the NPDs assayed produced statistically significant HTR above the vehicle-treated baseline.

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR counts per 15-min bin across 60 min plus 15–30 min summary window.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: HTR counts are plotted as the number of counts per 15-min intervals... analyzed for every 15-min interval to establish a control HTR profile for the full 60 min evaluation.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Only count data per bin reported; no transitions or sequences.

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is a drug-induced reflexive behavior, excluded as ethological per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Mice were singly housed and tested individually.

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR does not require learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Behavioral analysis was conducted by an individual blinded to the subject treatment group using BORIS — manual scoring.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in the test chamber.

assays.assay_description: Mice subjected to a 7-day mild chronic stress paradigm (corticosterone in drinking water + 30 min daily restraint) were given a single oral dose of vehicle, psilocybin (1 mg/kg), or NPD (10 mg/kg) 24 h before testing. Each mouse was placed alone in a chamber with 10 glass marbles on a 5-cm layer of wood-chip bedding for 20 min; % marbles buried was scored on Day 1 (24 h) and Day 7 (168 h) post-dose.

application_type.evidence: All test articles were administered as a single dose (p.o.) 24 h after the MCSP.

setup_habituation.evidence: During the last 2 days of the protocol, mice were exposed to the plexiglass test chamber without marbles for 10 min to reduce the impact of cage novelty.

setup_restrain.evidence: Each mouse was placed individually in a prepared test chamber, allowed to explore for 20 min — freely moving during recording. (Restraint stress used during MCSP conditioning, not during MBT recording.)

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the marble-burying chamber during the 20 min test.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the chamber during the 20 min test.

time_to_assay.evidence: MBT was conducted on days 1 and 7 postadministration.

sample_size.evidence: n = 7 mice for vehicle and psilocybin nonstress groups, n = 11 mice for vehicle stress group, n = 8 mice for psilocybin stress group, n = 6 mice for NPD stress groups.

outcomes.summary: Chronic-stressed mice showed elevated marble burying that persisted for 7 days. A single oral dose of psilocybin (1 mg/kg) returned burying to non-stressed baseline at both Day 1 and Day 7. NPDs ES01, ES02, and T01 (10 mg/kg) all reduced burying at Day 1; ES01 and T01 also rescued the phenotype at Day 7, whereas ES02 did not. Psilocybin had no effect on burying in non-stressed mice. No noticeable sex/gender bias.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin treatment resulted in a significantly reduced number of buried marbles by chronically stressed mice, completely returning them to their innate behavioral state, with long-term benefits lasting up to 7 days post-treatment... All three NPDs tested induced a significant reduction in marble-burying behavior in stressed mice at 1-day postdose. Two of these candidate prodrugs, ES01... and T01... produced notable long-term positive outcomes... up to 7 days after treatment.

B1_num_measures.evidence: A final assessment of % marbles buried was reported.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Single endpoint count per 20-min session; no within-session time course.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate anxiety/compulsive-like behavior; no learning required.

E1_environment_type.evidence: plexiglass test chamber with marbles on bedding.

E3_bedding.evidence: even 5 cm layer of wood-chip bedding.

E5_enrichment.evidence: Marbles are test stimuli, not enrichment.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in apparatus during 20-min test.

D1_continuity.evidence: MBT was conducted on days 1 and 7 postadministration.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug MBT baseline trial reported.

judge_notes: All three candidates agreed on two behavioural assays: HTR and MBT. Consolidated accordingly.

B1 for HTR: candidates split between 0 (1 measure) and 1 (2–3 measures, full 60-min profile + 15–30 min window). Adopted score 1 with medium confidence — paper reports counts across multiple 15-min bins and the 15–30 min window summary, plausibly counted as multiple measures, though all are subscores of HTR.
group_housing scored 'yes' (modal): mice were group-housed for 1 week on arrival, then singly housed 2 days before HTR/MBT testing. Noted the switch in evidence.

setup_restrain for MBT: MCSP includes 30-min restraint stress as a conditioning manipulation, but the MBT recording session itself has freely moving animals — scored 'no' per rubric (restraint during recording).
Dosing entries consolidated per compound; created an aggregated entry for the additional NPDs screened only at 1 mg/kg in HTR to capture them without inflating the list.
